text: {"lessons":["The account’s recent decline after strong gains reminds me that short-term price moves are unpredictable; I should not try to time the market from recent performance.","Selling Stock A at a large gain did not prevent later portfolio losses, so I should base trades on my overall plan and risk rather than the comfort of locking in a profit.","Since losses affect me more than equal gains, I should avoid panic-selling during downturns and review my holdings calmly before acting."]}
